card.name: Down arrows in drug interaction tables
card.fires_on: The down arrow symbol (↓) in drug-interaction tables, mainly for antiretroviral drugs. It marks a decrease in drug levels, often right after a drug name or inside a percent-change range.

modes.label: Arrow after drug name
modes.description: A down arrow follows a co-administered drug name and precedes the affected drug.

modes.label: Arrow in change range
modes.description: A down arrow sits inside a numeric percent-change range with confidence limits.

card.plain: It fires on the downward arrow that shows a drug's level goes down in interaction tables.
